title: Taiwanese Romance Scam Ring Allegedly Used AI Voice-Changing Software to Defraud More Than 20,000 People
summary: Taiwanese prosecutors alleged that a romance-fraud ring used custom AI voice-changing software to impersonate women during phone calls with men contacted through dating apps. The operation reportedly defrauded more than 20,000 people of at least NT$900 million (about US$28.3 million) through deceptive relationships and demands for money and gifts. Prosecutors indicted 57 people in connection with the scheme.
